{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Inspect the data
print(data.info())
print('\nFirst few rows:')
print(data.head())

# Check for the QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
print('\nRows with revenue == 999999.99:')
print(data[data['revenue'] == '999999.99'])

# Check for refunded orders
print('\nRefunded orders:')
print(data[data['status'] == 'refunded'])

# Check for missing values in customer_age
print('\nNumber of -1 values in customer_age:')
print(data[data['customer_age'] == -1]['customer_age'].count())"}
